title: Numerical issues in logits and softmax

cues.en: You have already encountered and used softmax many times in this course, and possibly also in other courses or applications.
cues.zh: 這門課已經多次使用 softmax，你也可能在其他課程或應用用過。

cues.en: What I'm going to discuss in this video is some numerical issues that can arise when calculating softmax
cues.zh: 這支影片要談，直接從原始 logits 計算 softmax 時，可能發生的數值問題，

cues.en: from raw logit values, especially in very large models with very large vocabs.
cues.zh: 尤其在詞彙表很大的超大型模型裡。

cues.en: This is a pretty serious issue, but fortunately there is a really simple fix.
cues.zh: 問題相當嚴重，但幸好修正非常簡單。

cues.en: And it turns out that PyTorch softmax function implements this kind of normalization.
cues.zh: 而且 PyTorch 的 softmax 函數，已經實作這種正規化。

cues.en: So this is a slide you've seen previously in the course.
cues.zh: 這張投影片之前看過。

cues.en: I just want to remind you very quickly about the formula for the softmax transformation and the goal of softmax.
cues.zh: 快速提醒 softmax 轉換的公式與目的。

cues.en: So softmax just means taking the natural exponential of some number, and dividing it by the sum over all of the natural exponentials of the whole data set.
cues.zh: softmax 就是對某個數取自然指數，再除以整組資料

cues.en: So all the relevant values.
cues.zh: 所有相關數值之自然指數的總和。

cues.en: The resulting softmax values are non-negative, and they are normalized such that they form a probability
cues.zh: 得到的 softmax 值非負，並經正規化，形成機率

cues.en: distribution.
cues.zh: 分布。

cues.en: In machine learning and in deep learning, the goal of a softmax transformation is to transform any
cues.zh: 機器學習與深度學習中，softmax 的目的，是把任何

cues.en: set of arbitrary values into a probability function.
cues.zh: 一組任意數值，轉成機率函數。

cues.en: In an LL, these values correspond to the output logits, which are the numbers for each possible token
cues.zh: 在 LLM，這些值就是輸出 logits，對應詞彙表裡

cues.en: in the vocab, and we would want to softmax.
cues.zh: 每個可能詞元；如果想得到所有詞元的機率分布，

cues.en: If we are trying to get a probability distribution over all the tokens in order to probabilistically generate new tokens.
cues.zh: 以機率方式生成新詞元，就會做 softmax。

cues.en: Okay, so that is all just a very quick reminder.
cues.zh: 以上是快速複習。
